findings.code_snippet:
from pydantic_ai.agent import Agent
from pydantic_ai.common_tools.tavily import tavily_search_tool

# Get API key from environment
api_key = os.getenv("TAVILY_API_KEY")
assert api_key is not None
findings.message: Code accesses credential files (SSH keys, AWS credentials, etc.). This could indicate credential theft attempts.
findings.remediation: Remove references to credential paths. Use environment variables or secrets managers. For docs, use placeholder paths (e.g., /path/to/config). Never load .env or token files in production code paths.

findings.code_snippet:
If `tvly` is not installed:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://cli.tavily.com/install.sh | bash
```

Or manually: `uv tool install tavily-cli` / `pip install tavily-cli`
findings.message: Remote code is downloaded and executed. This bypasses code review and could introduce malicious code.
findings.remediation: Avoid downloading and executing remote scripts. Use trusted packages from PyPI/npm. If remote fetch is required, verify checksums and use HTTPS.

findings.code_snippet:
setup, run:

```bash
tvly init --skip-auth
```

This installs or updates the Tavily skills and verifies a live keyless search.
findings.message: Tool parameters are crafted to achieve unintended or unsafe behavior. Parameter abuse can bypass intended safety checks (e.g. shell=True, --force, dangerous glob patterns).
findings.remediation: Validate all tool parameters against an allowlist. Reject dangerous parameter values (shell=True, --force, -rf /) and use safe defaults.

findings.code_snippet:
If `tvly` is not installed:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://cli.tavily.com/install.sh | bash
```

Or manually: `uv tool install tavily-cli` / `pip install tavily-cli`
findings.message: Tool calls are chained to bypass individual safety checks or escalate capabilities beyond what any single tool call would allow.
findings.remediation: Limit tool chaining depth and validate the output of each tool before passing it to the next. Require explicit user approval for multi-step chains.

findings.code_snippet:
setup, run:

```bash
tvly init --skip-auth
```

This installs or updates the Tavily skills and verifies a live keyless search.
findings.message: Tool defaults are unsafe or overly permissive (e.g. disabled TLS verification, no authentication, world-writable permissions). Unsafe defaults widen the attack surface.
findings.remediation: Override unsafe defaults with secure settings (verify=True, auth required, restrictive permissions). Review and harden all tool configurations.

findings.message: Shadow Command Trigger: description clause 'extract pages, save a site as local markdown files, or says "crawl", "get all the pages", "download the docs", "extract everything under /docs", "bulk extract", or needs content from many pages on the same domain' conflicts with built-in command 'save'
findings.remediation: Choose triggers that do not conflict with built-in commands or other skills. Prefix with a unique namespace if necessary.
